backlog.spec: Replace construct_packing with a multi-start optimizer: variables are x,y,r for 26 circles (78 vars). Maximize sum r with scipy SLSQP, constraints: r<=x<=1-r, r<=y<=1-r, and pairwise (xi-xj)^2+(yi-yj)^2-(ri+rj)^2>=0 with analytic Jacobians. Start from random centers with r=0.05, seed fixed (np.random.default_rng(0)). Loop starts until 180s elapsed, keep best. Finally shrink radii by 1e-12 and verify validity.
backlog.title: SLSQP joint centers+radii from random starts

backlog.spec: After any center optimization, fix centers and solve an LP with scipy.optimize.linprog (maximize sum r s.t. r_i+r_j<=d_ij, r_i<=border distances, r>=0) to get exactly optimal radii, then subtract 1e-12 from each radius for safe validity.
backlog.title: Final LP radii polish

backlog.spec: Initialize centers from a 5x5 grid plus one extra circle in a gap, add Gaussian noise sigma 0.02, with r=0.08, then run SLSQP. Multi-start over noise seeds within time budget.
backlog.title: Grid-perturbed starts (5x5+1)

backlog.spec: Generate starts from hexagonal row layouts (row counts like 5,5,5,5,6 or 6,5,6,5,4 totalling 26), jittered by 0.01-0.03, then SLSQP joint optimization. Pick best across layouts and seeds.
backlog.title: Hex-lattice starts with rows 5-5-5-5-6 variants

backlog.spec: After finding a good SLSQP solution, repeatedly perturb: move 1-3 random circles (or the smallest) to random positions with small radii, or jitter all centers by sigma 0.03, re-run SLSQP, accept if improved (or Metropolis). Run until 200s.
backlog.title: Basin hopping on best solution

backlog.spec: Before SLSQP, run Adam/L-BFGS on penalty loss -sum r + mu*(overlap^2 + boundary violation^2) with mu increasing 10→1e4 across stages, from random starts; then polish with SLSQP. Cheap way to produce many decent starts.
backlog.title: Penalty-method gradient descent warmup

backlog.spec: Start with all radii tiny and slowly inflate: repeated SLSQP solves with an added constraint sum r <= target, increasing target in steps until infeasible; helps avoid bad local minima.
backlog.title: Radii-growth schedule

backlog.spec: Init radii as function of distance from center (big at center ~0.13, small near edges ~0.07) with centers on jittered rings; run SLSQP.
backlog.title: Larger circles central initialization

backlog.spec: Pin four circles in corners (center=(r,r) etc, r variable) by reducing variables, and randomize other 22 circles; SLSQP. Reduces search dimensions and encodes the known structure.
backlog.title: Corner-fixed circles

backlog.spec: Init: 4 corner circles, ~12 edge circles evenly along borders, ~10 interior circles in a jittered hex pattern. SLSQP then basin hopping.
backlog.title: Edge ring + interior structure

backlog.spec: Use scipy trust-constr with sparse Jacobian and the same constraints instead of SLSQP for polishing the best 3 candidates, compare sums and keep best valid.
backlog.title: Trust-constr alternative

backlog.spec: In SLSQP, include pairwise constraints only for pairs with center distance < 0.45 at start, rebuild the active set every few restarts; reduces constraints from 325 to ~120 and speeds up so more starts fit in the budget.
backlog.title: Only near-neighbor constraints

backlog.spec: Implement constraint function and Jacobian fully vectorized with numpy index arrays (np.triu_indices) to speed SLSQP 10x, allowing many hundreds of starts.
backlog.title: Vectorized analytic Jacobian

backlog.spec: Search packings with mirror symmetry about the diagonal: 26 = k on-diagonal + pairs. Optimize half the variables, then release symmetry and polish with full SLSQP.
backlog.title: Symmetry-constrained search

backlog.spec: From the best solution, remove the smallest circle and reinsert it at the largest empty hole (found via max-min distance on a fine grid sample), re-optimize with SLSQP; iterate.
backlog.title: Radius-sorted mutation of smallest circle

backlog.spec: SA on centers only; objective is LP-optimal sum of radii (linprog highs). Temperature decays 0.01→1e-4, step sigma 0.02 decaying. Finish with SLSQP polish.
backlog.title: Simulated annealing over centers with LP radii

backlog.spec: Generate starts by running 20 Lloyd iterations on random points in the square (grid-sampled approximate centroids), producing evenly spread centers, then radii from LP and SLSQP.
backlog.title: Voronoi/Lloyd relaxation starts

backlog.spec: Use a smoothed objective stage: maximize sum r minus small entropy-like repulsion term sum 1e-4/d_ij, decaying to zero over 3 stages of SLSQP.
backlog.title: Soft-min objective smoothing

backlog.spec: Maintain a pool of 8 best solutions; each iteration pick one, perturb with random sigma in [0.01,0.08], SLSQP re-optimize, replace the worst if better. Fixed seed.
backlog.title: Parallel tempering style restarts pool

backlog.spec: At the end, compute exact violations in double precision; shrink each radius by 1e-10 then iteratively reduce any radius involved in an overlap (r_i+r_j>d) until all constraints hold with zero tolerance; return sum.
backlog.title: Safe validity shrink with verification

backlog.spec: Use time.time() with a hard deadline of 200s for the search loop, and always keep a fallback valid solution from LP on the initial ring layout so the function never crashes.
backlog.title: Time-budget guard

backlog.spec: Initial radii drawn from a lognormal around 0.1 with big spread, centers uniform; SLSQP. Diverse size distributions find different topologies (e.g. a few big circles plus many small).
backlog.title: Random starts with varied radius mix

backlog.spec: Run SLSQP with ftol=1e-6 maxiter=100 on many starts, keep top 10 by sum, then re-run on those with ftol=1e-12 maxiter=1000.
backlog.title: Two-stage coarse-to-fine tolerance

backlog.spec: Initialize with a central circle, ring of 6-7 medium circles, ring of ~12 and corners filled by 4 small circles, scaled to the square with jitter; SLSQP and basin hopping. Test several ring counts.
backlog.title: Known-structure init: 3 concentric-like layers

backlog.spec: In basin hopping, include moves that swap positions of a large and a small neighbor circle, or exchange radii initial values, then re-optimize with SLSQP.
backlog.title: Swap-move between neighbor sizes

backlog.spec: Add constraint r_i >= 0.03 in early SLSQP runs to avoid degenerate tiny circles, then drop it in the final polish.
backlog.title: Lower-bound radii constraint

backlog.spec: Start from a 6x6 lattice (36 sites), remove 10 random sites, jitter, give r=0.07; SLSQP. Multi-start over vacancy choices.
backlog.title: Square-lattice with vacancies

backlog.spec: Event-style simulation: each iteration inflate radii by 1%, resolve overlaps by pushing centers apart along connecting lines (several relaxation passes), shaking with decaying noise; after convergence polish with SLSQP.
backlog.title: Inflate-and-shake physics model

backlog.spec: After SLSQP, identify active constraints (slack<1e-9) and solve the equality-constrained system with Newton iterations (np.linalg.lstsq) to squeeze last 1e-10 precision, then shrink radii by 1e-13.
backlog.title: Active-set refinement via KKT Newton

backlog.spec: Take best solution, generate perturbations ±delta (antithetic pairs) with delta in several scales, optimize each with SLSQP, and move to the best; repeat as an evolution-strategy loop.
backlog.title: Multi-start with antithetic perturbation of best

incumbent.description: Replace the uniform random starts with a 5x5 grid plus one random extra circle, Gaussian noise sigma 0.02, r0=0.08, and a multi-start over noise seeds (time-capped) that keeps the best SLSQP result before the hole-refinement loop.
